# Image Carousel

## Summary
Catalog image carousel: cycles a list of image URLs with arrows and dot
navigation — the component behind catalog listing screenshot heroes. Lives
in the catalog realm at `catalog-app/components/image-carousel` (default
export).

## API
- `@items` — `string[]` of image URLs
- Blocks: `icon` (badge over the image), optional `overlay`

## Usage
```gts
import ImageCarousel from 'https://realms-staging.stack.cards/catalog/catalog-app/components/image-carousel';

<ImageCarousel @items={{this.imageUrls}}>
  <:icon></:icon>
</ImageCarousel>
```
The linked example is a live shared-realm demo over three images.
